selection: fixed seeded subset from each saved cohort, without reading policy outcomes; preserve original scenario indices/permutations
enum_order: independently shuffled per original scenario index and repetition; same across arms and graph variants; never copied from display order

metrics_before_run.stability: student selection variability across the original three display permutations
metrics_before_run.position: first display position and first schema enum position among valid calls, both reported
metrics_before_run.comparison: archived legacy outputs on exactly the same selected cases; two new arms use the same model and runtime options
metrics_before_run.claims: bounded exploratory development; the objective arm explicitly follows the B+ numeric rule, so agreement measures rule execution, not pedagogical value
metrics_before_run.follow_up: no automatic prompt/model search; retain all arms and failures; full VALIDATION required before any Lock C
